techguns.power.tooltip.nuclear_generator: 400 FE/t from nuclear micro reactors, needs water
techguns.power.jei.nuclear_generator: Burns nuclear micro reactors: 400 FE/t, 4,800,000 FE each. Needs water next to it, or it overheats and stops.
techguns.power.tooltip.wind_turbine: Stack it: base, 1-6 masts, head. Up to 100 FE/t
techguns.power.jei.wind_turbine: Stack the same block: base at the bottom, 1-6 masts, head on top. No wind below Y 64, up to 100 FE/t at Y 128. Blocks around the head take wind away.
techguns.power.jei.solar_panel: 20 FE/t in daylight under open sky, half in rain.
techguns.power.jei.solar_panel_advanced: 60 FE/t in daylight under open sky, half in rain.
techguns.power.jei.solar_panel_industria: 160 FE/t in daylight under open sky, half in rain.
techguns.power.tooltip.energy_cell: Stores 1,000,000 FE, output through the front
techguns.power.jei.energy_cell: Stores 1,000,000 FE. Takes energy on every side but the front and gives it through the front. Comparators read its charge.
techguns.power.tooltip.energy_bank: Stores 10,000,000 FE, output through the front
techguns.power.jei.energy_bank: Stores 10,000,000 FE, moves 10,000 FE/t. Takes energy on every side but the front and gives it through the front.
techguns.power.jei.energy_cable: Joins cables and every block that takes or gives FE, carries up to 5,000 FE/t without losses.
techguns.power.jei.floodlight: Uses 2 FE/t and lights a beam 24 blocks ahead until a wall stops it.
techguns.plant.missing: Plant incomplete: %s needed (%s wrong blocks marked)
techguns.plant.blocked: Plant incomplete: %s blocks in the way (marked)
techguns.plant.wind_plant.tip1: Place on the ground, 8-24 tower sections on top,
techguns.plant.wind_plant.tip2: a casing on the tower, a rotor hub with 3 blades in front of it.
techguns.plant.wind_plant.tip3: Up to 1000 FE/t, more the higher (full at Y 150).
techguns.plant.geothermal_plant.tip1: 3x3x2 of casing, this in the front middle at the bottom.
techguns.plant.geothermal_plant.tip2: 15 FE/t per lava source in the 5x5x3 space below.
techguns.plant.fission_reactor.tip1: 3x3x3 of casing (glass in side middles), empty centre,
techguns.plant.fission_reactor.tip2: this in the front middle. 3000 FE/t from micro reactors,
techguns.plant.fusion_reactor.tip1: 5x5x3: casing top and bottom, a ring of magnet coils
techguns.plant.fusion_reactor.tip2: in the middle around an empty 3x3, this in the front of the ring.
techguns.plant.fusion_reactor.tip3: Ignition 2M FE, then 8000 FE/t from water (20 mB/t).
techguns.plant.rotor_hub.need: Hang %s more blades on the hub
techguns.plant.rotor_hub.no_tower: The hub must sit on the front of the nacelle of a wind plant
techguns.plant.rotor_hub.tip1: Goes on the front of the wind plant nacelle.
techguns.plant.rotor_hub.tip2: Right-click with 3 blades to hang them,
techguns.plant.rotor_hub.tip3: then right-click the hub to start the plant.
techguns.plant.rotor_hub.tip4: Sneak + empty hand takes a blade off.
techguns.plant.fill_not_formed: Assemble the plant first, then pour the water into any of its blocks (or into the controller right away)
techguns.plant.fill_wrong: This tank takes only water, or it is full
techguns.wire.first: Wire start fixed — click the second insulator
techguns.wire.other_world: The wire start is in another dimension
techguns.wire.exists: There is already a wire here
techguns.power.jei.power_bus: High-voltage duct of copper bus bars, up to 524,288 FE/t with no loss. Joins only generators, power plants, transformers and high-voltage insulators. Feed machines through a transformer.
techguns.power.jei.wire_coil_copper: Copper wire: 2,048 FE/t, up to 16 blocks. Use it on one insulator, then on another.
techguns.power.jei.wire_coil_steel: Steel wire: 16,384 FE/t, up to 24 blocks. Also hangs on power pylons.
techguns.power.jei.wire_coil_high_voltag: High-voltage wire: 131,072 FE/t, up to 48 blocks, almost lossless. Only on high-voltage insulators, the transformer top and pylons.
techguns.power.jei.wire_connector_copper: Insulator for copper wire. Place it on a machine, cable or cell.
techguns.power.jei.wire_connector_steel: Insulator for copper and steel wire.
techguns.power.jei.wire_connector_high_v: Insulator for high-voltage wire. Works only on a generator, power plant, transformer or bus duct; high voltage never goes to machines.
techguns.power.jei.transformer: Stores 20,000,000 FE and steps power down: at the front it gives a bus duct up to 524,288 FE/t, cables and machines what they carry, takes from the sides, back and bottom. Front bushing: copper and steel wire; top: high-voltage.
techguns.power.jei.pylon: An 8-block power pylon with four points for steel and high-voltage wire.
techguns.power.jei.wind_plant: Wind farm controller. Build the tower, hub and blades as shown in the book, then use the controller.
techguns.power.jei.geothermal_plant: Geothermal plant controller. Goes above lava; the layout is in the book.
techguns.power.jei.fission_reactor: Fission reactor controller. Needs water and fuel; the layout is in the book.
techguns.power.jei.fusion_reactor: Fusion reactor controller. Needs water and 2,000,000 FE to ignite; the layout is in the book.
techguns.power.jei.plant_casing: Power plant casing, the main block of every plant.
techguns.power.jei.rotor_hub: Rotor hub: use a blade on it to fit the blade.
techguns.power.jei.turbine_blade: Wind turbine blade, fitted to the hub.
techguns.wire.hv_only: A high-voltage insulator only works on a generator, power plant, transformer or bus duct
death.attack.wire_shock.player: %s grabbed a live wire whilst fighting %s
techguns.wire.tip.bare: Bare: shocks under load, armour does not help
techguns.power.jei.wire_coil_copper_insu: Copper wire in rubber insulation: 2,048 FE/t, up to 16 blocks, never shocks.
techguns.power.jei.wire_coil_steel_insul: Insulated steel wire: 16,384 FE/t, up to 24 blocks, never shocks.
techguns.tooltip.blueprints: Use to learn how to fabricate cybernetic parts
techguns.blueprints.learned: You learned how to fabricate cybernetic parts
techguns.tooltip.needblueprints: The machine owner must study the cybernetics blueprints
techguns.tooltip.steamupgrade: Chemical Laboratory: boils water into steam. Metal Press: steam tank, builds pressure
techguns.tooltip.windowframe: Right-click with a glass pane to glaze, with an empty hand to take it out
techguns.tooltip.fluid_pipe: Moves up to %s mB/t from tanks to other tanks
techguns.gun.tooltip.ammoswitch.key: Press %s to switch ammunition type (or combine the weapon with the rounds in crafting)
techguns.msg.noammotype: No other ammunition type in the inventory
